name: FutureX
description: FutureX is a dynamic and live evaluation benchmark designed for LLM agents performing future prediction tasks. It supports real-time daily updates and eliminates data contamination through an automated pipeline, enabling comprehensive assessment of agents' adaptive reasoning and performance in dynamic environments.
reputation: A very recent live benchmark that is still early in community adoption, with interest mainly from researchers studying dynamic and contamination-resistant evaluation.
notes: Supports real-time daily updates and contamination-free evaluation; evaluates 25 LLM/agent models including those with reasoning and external tool integration.
